description: Claims-system write API is not certified for the rollout window
contingency: Launch read-only assistance and defer protected writes

description: Cross-tenant authorization defect appears in preproduction
contingency: Stop promotion and repair tenant enforcement

description: Effective-date metadata is incomplete for a rollout jurisdiction
contingency: Remove the jurisdiction from scope and repair metadata

description: Training completion falls below 90 percent before a rollout wave
trigger: Completion is below target three days before cutover
contingency: Limit the wave to trained adjusters and add office hours

description: p95 latency exceeds 12 seconds under rollout load
trigger: Two consecutive monitoring windows exceed the SLO
contingency: Disable the feature flag and continue manual handling

description: An executive requests enterprise-wide rollout before wave evidence
trigger: Requested cohort exceeds the approved wave boundary
contingency: Require a new scope decision and readiness review

description: Primary or backup on-call coverage is missing during cutover
trigger: Any severity-one slot lacks both roles
contingency: Delay cutover or add approved coverage

description: Customer-specific adapter changes leak into shared platform code
trigger: Shared-core pull request contains Northstar-only logic
contingency: Move logic to the isolated extension and review the contract
